content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using a [product_name] with [article_no] and the [product_name] software [version_no]. I enabled the web server through Tools -> Transfer -> Access Control, but when I try to connect over the local network, I see a 'web user disable' message. I can't locate where to set or change the web server password. How can I activate this feature? Thank you.
Within Access Control, select 'Enable Web User' by setting the checkbox. Then enter a new password, confirm it, and click 'Apply' to save your changes.
I realize now the solution was there—I didn't scroll enough.
The key thing is that it's working now.
When I connect the operator device, it works fine, but on the web server, when I choose the menu for the operator device, the page stays blank. Is this an issue with my program? Thanks.

Your [product_name], identified by [article_no], is the current [product_name] [version_no]. It actually has two web server functionalities: a basic one and an extended one. The basic web server visually displays screens from [product_name] and the operator device, including buttons, but only shows message texts—not the full menu view. To display messages, you need to select the appropriate option when creating a message. For [product_name]: message is shown only on the device, for operator device: message appears only on that device, both: message displayed on both, and web server: message shown online. You can combine these settings. This allows your message text to appear on the physical device, operator device, and through the web server. The extended web server lets you design custom web pages using the free '[product_name] Web Editor' software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users found the activation and configuration of the web server on a [product_name] using [product_name] software [version_no] confusing. The main challenges included locating the correct user interface options to enable the server, activating the web user, and setting the password. There was further misunderstanding about how message texts display across the device, operator panels, and web server, which led to unmet expectations regarding web menu visibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple process for enabling the web server, setting up web user credentials, and having the same message or menu visible on the web interface as on the operator device.
